tools.name: get_user_by_username
tools.description: Get an X (Twitter) user's profile by handle: name, bio, follower/following counts, verification, created date, and the numeric user ID (rest_id) needed by other tools.

username.description: X handle without the URL, e.g. "elonmusk" (a leading @ is fine).

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of JSON to return (default 50000). Longer output is cut with a [TRUNCATED] marker. Lower it to save context, raise it if you need the full response.

format.description: Response format (default simple). simple: compact JSON with flat camelCase tweets and users, about 60% fewer tokens. raw: X's full GraphQL JSON, only needed for fields simple leaves out (cards, polls, edit history, community notes).

instructions:
Tools for reading public X (Twitter) data through TwittrAPI.
Responses use the compact simple format by default: {"data": ...} with flat camelCase tweets and users (id, text, createdAt, author, counts, media, ...). Pass format "raw" to a tool only if you need fields it leaves out (cards, polls, edit history, community notes).
Output is cut at max_chars (default 50000).
Most user tools accept userId or username; resolve a handle once with username_to_id and reuse the ID.
Paginated tools print next_cursor at the top of the result; pass it back as cursor for the next page.
A 402 error means the account has no balance: stop and tell the user. Every call is billed.
stderr: twittrapi-mcp: no TWITTRAPI_API_KEY or RAPIDAPI_KEY set. Tools will be listed but calls will fail until a key is configured.
